memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia: status ongoing, patient reports difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakenings. Plan: start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, counsel sleep hygiene.
- Asthma: status mild intermittent, uses salbutamol SOS. Plan: continue salbutamol SOS, start budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS.
- Vitamin D deficiency: status deficient. Plan: cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU OD.
- Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (male cutoff 90 cm, elevated). Advice: reduce refined carbs, increase protein.
- Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.
